discovery_expectations.text: Tests get_wait_time returning 0 but subsequent is_allowed fails (TOCTOU: get_wait_time refills but does not reserve tokens)
discovery_expectations.evidence: No test specifically verifies the TOCTOU pattern: get_wait_time returns 0 then immediate is_allowed fails. The test 'test_get_wait_time_does_not_consume_tokens' verifies non-consumption but not the race condition scenario.

discovery_expectations.text: Tests cost=0 is always allowed even when bucket is empty (degenerate input)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test_returns_true_when_cost_is_zero: RateLimiter(max_tokens=0, refill_rate=1.0), is_allowed('user1', cost=0.0) is True — even empty bucket allows zero-cost

discovery_expectations.text: Tests negative cost parameter (adds tokens instead of consuming them)
discovery_expectations.evidence: @pytest.mark.skip(reason='BUG: negative cost increases token balance above max_tokens') test_negative_cost_does_not_increase_token_balance_BUG

discovery_expectations.text: Tests cleanup_expired does not remove active keys that just made requests recently
Tests token accumulation over many rapid refill cycles for floating point drift
discovery_expectations.evidence: No test for floating point accumulation drift over many rapid refill cycles. The test_tokens_refill_proportionally_to_elapsed_time uses pytest.approx but tests a single refill, not many cycles.

discovery_expectations.text: Tests create_burst_limiter with burst followed by sustained requests at exactly the refill rate
discovery_expectations.evidence: test_create_burst_limiter_allows_burst_then_throttles: burst_size=3, sustained_per_second=1.0 — 3 burst requests, then blocked, then 1 refilled at t=101

discovery_expectations.text: Tests interaction between multiple keys (keys are independent, no cross-contamination)
discovery_expectations.evidence: test_different_keys_are_rate_limited_independently: exhausting user1 does not affect user2; test_handles_many_independent_keys: 100 independent keys each get their own bucket

format_expectations.text: Documents at least one discovered bug as a skipped test with BUG notation
format_expectations.evidence: @pytest.mark.skip(reason='BUG: negative cost increases token balance above max_tokens') on test_negative_cost_does_not_increase_token_balance_BUG; also test_get_wait_time_with_zero_refill_rate_raises_meaningful_error_BUG and test_get_wait_time_does_not_call_clean_window_BUG

format_expectations.text: Provides a structured test coverage summary at the end
format_expectations.evidence: summary.md contains '## Test Coverage Summary' table, '## Key Findings About Behavior', and '## Bugs Discovered' section with 3 numbered bugs

quality_expectations.text: Generated tests compile and run without syntax errors
quality_expectations.evidence: Standard pytest syntax with correct imports from rate_limiter; no syntax errors detected

quality_expectations.text: Skipped BUG tests actually fail when unskipped (bug is real, not a false positive)
quality_expectations.evidence: Negative cost bug is real: entry.tokens -= (-1.0) adds 1 token; ZeroDivisionError on refill_rate=0 is real: deficit/0 raises ZeroDivisionError

quality_expectations.text: No false positive bugs reported (behavior that is actually correct flagged as wrong)
quality_expectations.evidence: All 3 bugs documented are genuine defects. No correct behavior was flagged as a bug.
